title: Copilot Studio: cost visibility in Preview chat and History
summary: The roadmap facts, credit estimates and usage-based billing statements are supported. Minor corrections should qualify when Power Platform spending controls apply, complete the allocation path and simplify the API call.

claims.claim: This roadmap item concerns cost visibility in Microsoft Copilot Studio.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Cost visibility in Preview Chat and History

claims.claim: The planned change shows consumption costs to makers in the Preview tab and agent history.
claims.quote: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within preview tab and agent history

claims.claim: The roadmap's cost visibility includes preview and testing usage.
claims.quote: for their preview/testing usage

claims.claim: The roadmap describes visibility for every historical run.
claims.quote: as well as all every historical run

claims.claim: The record still lists the feature as In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development", "statusKey": "in-development"

claims.claim: The roadmap target is September CY2026, a month already past on the run date.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "September CY2026"

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant) is the only cloud listed in the record.
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.where: front matter: platforms; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists the Web platform.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Web"]

claims.claim: The record lists General Availability as the release phase.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability"]

claims.claim: The record supplies no preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": null

claims.claim: The item has no more-info link.
claims.quote: "moreInfoLink": null

claims.where: What's changing; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The roadmap description does not specify which agent harnesses it covers.
claims.quote: Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage costs transparent throughout the development experience.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Preview chat shows a running total of estimated Copilot Credits for the current test session.
claims.quote: The Preview chat shows a running total of estimated Copilot Credits used during the current test session.

claims.claim: The Preview estimate updates during interaction and helps compare the consumption effects of prompts, knowledge and tools.
claims.quote: It updates as you interact with the agent. This feature helps you understand how different prompts, instructions, knowledge sources, and tools affect consumption before you publish your agent.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The History view includes a Credits used column containing estimated credits for past conversations.
claims.quote: Credits used | The estimated Copilot Credits used during the session. Use this column to compare conversations and identify sessions that consumed more credits than expected.

claims.claim: The cited Preview and History documentation concerns Microsoft Copilot harness agents, which the History prerequisites explicitly name.
claims.quote: The Preview tab in agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness in Microsoft Copilot Studio maintains a history of your test conversations. Prerequisites: An agent created with the Microsoft Copilot harness

claims.claim: Learn does not identify these documented screens as the shipped implementation of roadmap item 571194.
claims.quote: Searched: Learn for '571194 cost visibility licence rollout'; read preview-overview, preview-history and billing-credit-understand-display. No explicit mapping to this roadmap item was found.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Preview and Evaluate credit estimates are near-real-time approximations.
claims.quote: The estimates in Preview and Evaluate are near-real-time approximations

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Monitor updates a few times a day, with final credit processing taking a few hours.
claims.quote: The view in Monitor is updated a few times a day ... the final, accurate number is reflected in Monitor within a few hours.

claims.claim: Monitor shows accurate consumption for events processed so far, not necessarily the complete bill before processing finishes.
claims.quote: the number might not reflect the entire bill until all activities for the selected period are processed

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: After processing completes, Monitor is authoritative and reflects the credits billed for the selected period.
claims.quote: This value reflects the number of Copilot Credits that will be billed for the selected period ... Once processing is complete, these values are the authoritative measure of credits consumed.

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot harness credit charging starts when building starts.
claims.quote: the Microsoft Copilot harness charges credits from the moment you start building

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Building, previewing, testing and evaluating Microsoft Copilot harness agents consume Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Experiences such as creating an automated solution with natural language, previewing and testing an agent, and generating and creating agent evaluations all consume credits.

claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot harness usage is not included with the user's Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.
claims.quote: This usage isn't included with a user's Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The billing table lists Microsoft Copilot harness agents as billed for all usage regardless of the user's licence.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot harness agents | No | Billed for all usage. Creation and runtime activities consume Copilot Credits regardless of the user's license.

claims.claim: The documented Microsoft Copilot harness experience uses a consumption licensing model.
claims.quote: Agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness use consumption-based billing.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Credits are charged to the environment where the agent runs rather than to individual makers or users.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are charged to the environment where the agent runs ... and not to the individual makers or users who run agents.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Under Power Platform billing, consumption uses prepaid capacity or the environment's pay-as-you-go billing plan.
claims.quote: from prepaid capacity or through the environment's pay-as-you-go billing plan

claims.claim: The cost management page says developer and trial environments move to usage-based billing on 1 September 2026.
claims.quote: Developer environments and trial environments move to usage-based billing September 1, 2026.

claims.claim: The display is not described as having a separate licence.
claims.quote: Searched: Learn 'estimated credit licens price' and '571194 cost visibility licence rollout'; read Preview, History, estimated-credit display, usage-based billing and harness cost-management pages. No separate display licence found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has published no rate or separate charge specific to displaying the estimates.
claims.quote: Searched: Learn 'estimated credit licens price'; read billing-credit-overview, billing-credit-understand-display and manage-usage-github-copilot-harness; reviewed Billing rates and management search excerpts. No display-specific charge found.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: The sources do not explicitly state whether the cost display is on by default for every maker.
claims.quote: Searched: Learn 'Copilot Studio Preview History credit display disable default administrator switch cost visibility' and 'Preview credit visibility admin toggle'; read Preview, History and estimated-credit display pages. No explicit rollout default found.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No administrator or maker switch specifically for hiding the cost display is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Learn 'Preview credits display disable' and 'Preview credit visibility admin toggle Copilot Studio'; read preview-overview, preview-history, billing-credit-understand-display and harness cost-management guidance. Debug mode is documented, not a credit-display switch.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: The documentation does not specify which other makers can see a maker's History credit figures.
claims.quote: Searched: Learn 'Copilot Studio History conversations other makers permissions'; read preview-history and search excerpts for Secure your Copilot Studio projects and harness access guidance. None specifies cross-maker access to Preview History credit figures.

claims.claim: The cited Learn pages describe credit figures without describing a new data source for this display.
claims.quote: The Preview chat shows a running total of estimated Copilot Credits used during the current test session.

claims.claim: History shows credit usage beside existing details including status, duration and steps.
claims.quote: Status | The outcome ... Steps/Turns | The number of processing steps and conversation turns ... Duration | How long the conversation lasted ... Credits used | The estimated Copilot Credits used during the session.

claims.claim: Preview History provides full conversation transcripts.
claims.quote: In the history view, select a conversation to open its details. Review the full message history, including user messages and agent responses.

claims.where: summary; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap describes a display change rather than new agent actions or data access.
claims.quote: Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage costs transparent throughout the development experience.

claims.claim: The credit display is informational rather than a consumption cap.
claims.quote: Whenever a credit value is an estimate, the user interface includes an information icon and an explanatory message indicating that the value is intended for planning purposes and will be finalized later.

claims.claim: Managing credit allocations requires Power Platform Administrator, Global Administrator or equivalent licensing and capacity permissions.
claims.quote: Sign in as a user with the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment reaches the allocation pane.
claims.quote: Under Products, select Copilot Studio, and then select Manage Copilot Credits. ... Select the environment ... Under Allocate capacity ... Under Capacity overages, select or clear Draw from the available capacity in my tenant
claims.fix: The path stops on the right pane. Extend controls[0].ui.path and the rendered table to 'Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant'; note that Allocate capacity on the same pane sets the allocation.

claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 updates environment allocations and tenant-pool draw.
claims.quote: Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put ... -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion" ... -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json" -Body $allocationBody
claims.fix: Set controls[0].api.call and the rendered code to 'PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01'. Remove the appended curl-style headers and -d placeholder. Add to the note: 'The request body sets scope.environmentId, allocatedEntitlements[].allocation.quantity and allocatedEntitlements[].enforcementRules with ruleType TenantPool and enabled false.' The cited tutorial documents JSON content type; the pre-check's missing literal Content-Type is not a functional error.

claims.claim: The printed JSON uses MCSMessages, scope.environmentId, allocation.quantity and a disabled TenantPool enforcement rule.
claims.quote: scope = @{ environmentId = $environmentId } ... entitlementId = "MCSMessages" ... allocation = @{ quantity = 5000 } ... enforcementRules = @( ... @{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false }

claims.where: Why it matters; controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Clearing tenant-capacity draw prevents consumption of unallocated prepaid tenant capacity after the allocation is used.
claims.quote: When you clear this option, the environment doesn't draw from unallocated prepaid capacity in the tenant after it consumes its allocation.

claims.where: Why it matters; controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Turning off tenant-pool draw does not stop consumption through a linked pay-as-you-go billing plan.
claims.quote: If the environment is linked to a pay-as-you-go billing plan, usage can continue through the linked Azure subscription.

claims.claim: Experiences requiring credits can stop working for makers and end users when the environment has no credits available.
claims.quote: When an environment has no available Copilot Credits, experiences that require credits can stop working. This limitation can affect both makers and end users.

claims.claim: The full allocation guidance path reaches Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant.
claims.quote: select Licensing ... Under Products, select Copilot Studio ... Select Manage Copilot Credits ... Select the environment ... Under Capacity overages, clear Draw from the available capacity in my tenant.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit opens agent monthly limits.
claims.quote: In the Power Platform admin center, go to Licensing > Copilot Studio. Select Manage Agents. Select the agent, and then select Set limit.

claims.claim: The agent monthly limit includes a configurable notification threshold.
claims.quote: Enter the monthly Copilot Credit limit. Configure the notification threshold.

claims.claim: An agent limit has a Stop usage option that turns the agent off at its limit.
claims.quote: Turn on Stop usage if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit.

claims.claim: A published environment group rule prevents individual draw-setting updates and returns TenantPoolLockedByPolicy.
claims.quote: Updates through the Power Platform admin center, Power Platform API, or administration SDKs are rejected with the TenantPoolLockedByPolicy error.

claims.where: summary; controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Environment allocations and linked billing plans govern the prepaid and pay-as-you-go spend described here.
claims.quote: To contain prepaid consumption, allocate a defined amount of Copilot Credits to the environment and turn off Draw from the available capacity in my tenant.
claims.fix: Qualify the allocation guidance and row note with: 'These Power Platform controls apply while spending remains managed in the Power Platform admin center. If a Microsoft 365 admin center resource-based spending policy covers the environment or agent, its controls take precedence for that usage; Power Platform capacity allocations and linked billing plans no longer apply to a covered environment.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/implement/usage-based-billing-manage-copilot-studio-costs, which documents this exception to the cited Power Platform guidance.

claims.claim: Learn does not specify a rollout mechanism, release channel or licence prerequisite for roadmap item 571194 itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Learn '571194 cost visibility licence rollout'; read preview-overview, preview-history and billing-credit-understand-display. These describe the harness experience, without item-specific rollout mechanics, release channel or licence prerequisites.

claims.claim: Variable cost identifies the documented Copilot Credits consumption meter.
claims.quote: Usage is billed based on consumption and measured in Copilot Credits.

claims.claim: Administrators control who can build agents through existing authoring and environment permissions.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot harness doesn't have its own maker-access setting. To control who can create agents, use your existing Copilot Studio and environment permissions.
